steps.en: After the 2nd letter, notices needing an e-reminder are selected
steps.id: Setelah surat kedua, notice yang perlu e-reminder dipilih
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off in production and only runs when triggered by hand.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan di produksi dan hanya jalan kalau dipicu manual.

steps.en: The latest mobile number or email is checked and the owner record updated
steps.id: Nomor HP atau email terbaru dicek dan data pemilik diperbarui
steps.why_en: The latest-contact lookup is switched off, so only stored contacts are used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan kontak terbaru dimatikan, jadi hanya kontak tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Notices without a usable contact are skipped
steps.id: Notice tanpa kontak yang bisa dipakai dilewati

steps.en: Opted-out or passport owners get no e-reminder
steps.id: Pemilik yang opt-out atau ber-paspor tidak dikirimi e-reminder
